title: Trancefloor — three repeated low notes
method: Hardware-only screening of the full recording found three separated repeated notes at 13.150, 13.554 and 13.954 seconds. Float 44.1 kHz audio, 4096-sample STFT and independent 0.18-0.25s Welch windows show low families around 38.9/77.8 Hz and odd lower-family harmonics around 116.7 Hz; the one-octave-lower family near 19.4 Hz is far weaker. The published single Upper tone has Super Saw OSC1 coarse 0 and OSC2 WIDE-off signed coarse -36, hence physical -12 semitones, with tone octave 0. These support played MIDI 39. No Septum render or candidate parameter search informed the notes or gates. Onsets come from 2 ms RMS transitions; note-offs estimate the start of sharp amplitude drops.
uncertainties: Original MIDI, velocities, controllers and exact capture patch/system state are unavailable. This is an audio-derived reconstruction.
Velocity 100 is an unfitted placeholder. The published filter velocity sensitivity is zero, but amplifier velocity sensitivity and output processing may affect level.

The opening 13 seconds contain continuous pitch motion and were deliberately excluded. The selected notes settle around the same low pitch; two highly spread Super Saws limit precise central-frequency inference.
Onsets are estimated within approximately 3 ms and note-offs within approximately 15 ms. The gaps contain short effects/release tails, so exact physical key release is not known.

The crop begins after a preceding phrase; hardware retains a quiet wet tail while the software starts with empty effect buffers. Before the first onset, the hardware residual is roughly 0.002-0.004 RMS versus playing levels around 0.2-0.3. This is not an effects-isolated capture.
The original patch retains portamento and OSC1 pitch-envelope depth -30. Their physical response, Super Saw phase allocation and source spread remain model uncertainties.
The final note ends before the 1.22-second crop; the next onset near 14.332 seconds is excluded. No crop-edge note-on or artificial sustained note was added.
